testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.SiteOperationApiTests

testcase.name: a duplicate that waits longer than the allowed time is told to retry - 409 SCOPE_BUSY()
publish, rollback and unpublish exclude each other - whichever holds the scope, the other two are refused()
unpublish with the wrong expected release is refused, with the right one it works, and a second unpublish is a no-op()
two requests with the same key at the same moment - both answer 200, one effect()
unpublish while a rollback or a publish owns the scope is 409 SCOPE_BUSY and leaves the site online()
an unpublish retried with its key converges()
a retry after a terminal failure runs again and can succeed - the failure left nothing behind()
a retry after the worker died - its lease expired - takes the scope over at once and completes the operation once()
a duplicate request of an operation that is still running waits for it, then finds the work done - no second effect()
the same Idempotency-Key twice is one effect and the same answer - another body with the key is refused()
a rollback that expected another active release is 409 ROLLBACK_STALE and changes nothing - the right expectation goes through()
rollback while a publish owns the scope is 409 SCOPE_BUSY with Retry-After and the holder - nothing changes, and it works once the scope is free()
